turns.text: How to Build a PHR application

must_contain: Building a PHR application is four ABDM milestones in order: P1, P2, P3 and P4
P4 is a health locker that keeps the person's records for the long term, and applies to an app that stores records rather than only displaying them
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 2: the panel described P1 in detail and built 'in this order' P1 to P3, with P4 missing. Source lines: catalogue/shared/glossary/phr.md as in naive-phr-milestones-01; 'P4 applies to an app that stores a person's records rather than only displaying them'.
